title: Anytime-Valid Answer Sufficiency Certificates for LLM Generation via Sequential Information Lift
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a technical, statistical method for controlling when an LLM stops generating text. It focuses on 'information sufficiency' and 'factual correctness' from a technical standpoint. It does not evaluate models on tasks related to religion, morals, or ethics, and its discussion of safety-critical applications is about the method's limitations rather than an ethical evaluation.
